What to look for: dxc_1_6_2112 (CE's oldest DXC, Linux Release) terminates with signal
SIGSEGV (CE-reported exit 139) compiling this source with -T ps_6_2 -E f -- the Linux face of
the crash the issue reports (Windows access violation / bad-cast text, all classified as
internal_failure). dxc_trunk instead prints a clean front-end diagnostic, "error: recursive
functions are not allowed: function 'f' calls recursive function 'f'", and stops before
reaching the code that used to crash. That diagnostic, not any absence of output, is the
signal that this is now rejected rather than crashed on.
